game_title: Return Or Print – Sleigh Stables Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Sleigh Stables, the sleigh stables: the hold guard must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Or Print: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on.
theme: Snowy Hold – Sleigh Stables: the sleigh stables
core_gameplay_loop: In Sleigh Stables, repeat each round: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the court_score value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the chapel bell using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The chapel bell reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the chapel bell is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 1 (intro tier): Return Or Print
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
